notes.subject: land of Canaan / land of merchants
notes.rationale: כנען read literally is Canaan, but many translators hear כנען as 'traffic/merchants' (cf. 'land of traffick' KJV); Tok Pisin keeps Kenan.

notes.subject: sucker/twig
notes.rationale: יניקותיו is literally 'its suckers/saplings' — young tender shoots, rendered 'pikinini diu' (young shoots).

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin needs the object pronoun with putim; Hebrew שמו carries it in suffix.

translation: ⟨את⟩ hed bilong ol pikinini diu i kirap nau, em i kaisim i go long graun bilong Kenan, long siti bilong ol man i wok long salim samting, em i putim ⟨em⟩ long hap.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i wok long salim samting
